title: Fastapi

# FastAPI
FastAPI is a modern Python web framework for building APIs.
## Features
FastAPI uses Python type hints and Pydantic for data validation.
It also provides automatic interactive API documentation.
## Common Uses
FastAPI is commonly used to build REST APIs and backend services.
It is suitable for applications that require high performance.

title: Genai

# Generative AI
Generative AI refers to artificial intelligence systems that can generate
new content based on patterns learned from existing data.
## Large Language Models
Large language models can process and generate natural language.
They are commonly used for summarization, question answering,
classification, and information extraction.
## Applications
Generative AI can be used for chatbots, document processing,
content generation, coding assistance, and knowledge retrieval.

# Machine Learning
Machine learning is a branch of artificial intelligence that allows
computers to learn patterns from data.
## Supervised Learning
Supervised learning uses labeled training data.
Common examples include classification and regression.
## Unsupervised Learning
Unsupervised learning works with data that does not have predefined labels.
Clustering is a common unsupervised learning technique.

title: Python

# Python
Python is a high-level, general-purpose programming language.
## Features
Python has a simple syntax and supports object-oriented programming.
It is widely used for automation, web development, data analysis, and artificial intelligence.
## Common Uses
Python can be used to build web applications, automate repetitive tasks,
analyze data, and develop machine learning applications.

title: Sql
text:
# SQL
SQL stands for Structured Query Language.
## Purpose
SQL is used to store, retrieve, update, and delete data in relational databases.
## Common Commands
SELECT is used to retrieve data.
INSERT is used to add data.
UPDATE is used to modify existing data.
DELETE is used to remove data.
## Databases
SQL is commonly used with relational database systems such as MySQL,
PostgreSQL, and SQLite.
